name: Victor Wembanyama
title: The one-legged fade
build_note: Listed 7-4, 235 lb, reported 8-0 wingspan (the same build as his approved look and his signature-move page). His look in kit/looks.json is approved.
steps: Back to the rim. Two bumps for space.
Turns on his right foot to face up.
Off the left foot, knee up, falling away.
aria: Animated illustration of Victor Wembanyama's one-legged fadeaway: back to the basket on the block, he bumps his defender twice, pivots on his right foot to face the rim, then rises off his left foot with his right knee up, falling away from the basket. Dashed lines at the release mark the defender's highest reach and Wembanyama's release point, well above it. An original drawing, not traced from footage, not to scale.
